title: Prospective analysis of treatment and disease progression in foot and ankle disorders
summary:
Diseases of the ankle or foot are common and are often treated surgically. Postoperatively, patients often describe discomfort and functional limitations, and changes in gait pattern have already been demonstrated. A poor and non-functional gait pattern can lead to complications or consequential damage and should be prevented. 
Therefore, the aim of this study is to investigate the course of patients after surgery for an ankle or foot injury and to define factors that influence the implementation of a normal gait pattern.
conditions: Diseases and injuries of the ankle joint and foot

interventions.name: Patients with foot or ankle disorders are examined as part of regular clinical and radiological examinations and additionally with questionnaires and gait and stress analysis.
Health checks are carried out by means of clinical examinations, questionnaires, gait analysis and stress testing.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who have undergone surgery for ankle or foot disorders
Healthy controls
Exclusion criteria:
Persons incapable of giving consent,
minors, patients who underwent surgery for ankle osteoarthritis,
pregnancy
